title: Downgrinded
description: A modpack that removes features from Minecraft to make it more beta and adds extra features.
body:
## Why Downgraded was made
I was wondering how much content I could cut out of minecraft using mods and datapacks so I created this modpack using beta 1.7.3 as the end result
## Mods without which the modpack would not be possible
- Item Obliterator - allowed me to remove blocks and items
- You Shall Not Spawn! - allowed me to removes mobs
- Biome Replacer - allowed me to removes biomes that would not fit beta
- Global Packs - loads datapack that changes worldgen automaticly
- Structurify - allowed me to remove all structures by default
  
Mods that are not listed are for optimization and extra
## You can use this modpack for your modpacks
Yes, I give you permission to use everything from this modpack as a base in your modpacks.
